grimme

Class Grimme

  • java.lang.Object
    • grimme.Grimme

  • public class Grimme
extends java.lang.Object
    Method to implement Grimme's DFT-D method as per doi 10.1002/jcc.20078 J Comp Chem, 2004 and the improved method in doi 10.1002/jcc.20495 (J Comp Chem, 2006)
